title: Explicit scheme information: the LoTE describes its scheme itself (Table 1, explicit column)

citation.quote: In case the scheme information is explicit the LoTE shall contain this component.

element.row: 6.3.0 List information placed directly in the list
element.comment: Derived: an explicit list contains ListAndSchemeInformation, and the direct placement is only for a list without it.

citation.quote: In case the LoTE does not contain this component, information about the list itself shall be provided within the list directly through the presence of the LoTEVersionIdentifier, the LoTESequenceNumber, the SchemeOperatorName, the ListIssueDateTime, and the NextUpdate elements.
